description: Vectorized rooftop area data for 90 cities in China is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Zhixin Zhang et al. Reliable information on building rooftops can inform the use of limited urban space. In recent decades, the demand for accurate and up-to-date data on the areas of rooftops on a large-scale is increasing. However, obtaining these data is challenging due to the limited capability of conventional computer vision methods and the high cost of 3D modeling involving aerial photogrammetry. Coverage: national (CN); published in 2022. Formats: Shapefile, Point cloud. The data are held in the data repository named in the paper and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence of the data is not stated in the sources read (the paper itself is open access). Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
